blocks.content: Simulation status diagram provides LED indicator lights which can display all working paths of UPS and current working status of it.

blocks.markdown:
Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)

| Green and on       | Rectifier is in normal working condition   |
|--------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Rectifier is in soft start condition       |
| Red and on         | Rectifier is in fault                      |
| Off                | Rectifier cannot work                      |
blocks.title: Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)

blocks.content: Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)

blocks.markdown:
Table 5-3: Description for status of indicator light of battery (BATT)

| Green and on       | Battery discharges normally                                                |
|--------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Battery low voltage discharge or battery is taking manual maintenance test |
| Red and on         | Battery is in fault (fault of battery or no battery)                       |
| Off                | Battery is being charged.                                                  |
blocks.title: Table 5-2: Description for status of indicator light of rectifier (REC)

blocks.content: Table 5-3: Description for status of indicator light of battery (BATT)
Table 5-4: Description for status of indicator light of bypass (BYP)

blocks.markdown:
| Green and on   | Power of load is supplied by bypass                                                                            |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Red and on     | Power of bypass is in fault or exceeds normal range, bypass static switch is in fault or load impact to bypass |
| Off            | Bypass is normal                                                                                               |
blocks.title: Table 5-3: Description for status of indicator light of battery (BATT)

blocks.content: Table 5-5: Description for status of indicator light of inverter (INV)

blocks.markdown:
| Green and on       | Power of load is supplied by inverter               |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Inverter starts or is in stand-by status (ECO mode) |
| Red and on         | Inverter is in fault                                |
| Off                | Inverter cannot work                                |
blocks.title: Table 5-5: Description for status of indicator light of inverter (INV)

blocks.content: Table 5-6: Description for status of indicator light of load (OUTPUT)

blocks.markdown:
| Green and on   | UPS has output                                                    |
|----------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Red and on     | Output switch of UPS is disconnected or has output but overloaded |
| Off            | UPS has no output                                                 |
blocks.title: Table 5-6: Description for status of indicator light of load (OUTPUT)

blocks.markdown:
| Green and on   | Operation is normal   |
|----------------|-----------------------|
| Yellow and on  | UPS gives alarm       |
| Red and on     | UPS is in fault       |
blocks.title: Table 5-7: Description for operation status (STATUS)
